content.title: 4 Promotional Villas and Network Works
summary: A residential development of four private promotional villas in Rouiba, executed under a comprehensive all-trades package (TCE) including roads and utility networks (VRD).
The project integrates structural execution, contemporary facade articulation, and dedicated site circulation to establish a cohesive residential enclave.
description: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the complete construction cycle for this residential development, managing the reinforced concrete structural works, interior and exterior finishes, and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) installations.

The civil works scope encompassed the delivery of dedicated roads and utility networks (VRD), ensuring fully integrated site drainage, utility connections, and paved pedestrian and vehicular access routes.
content.authority: A residential development demonstrating precise coordination between structural execution, contemporary envelope finishes, and integrated civil utility networks.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Rouiba residential project?
faq.answer: The project comprises the construction of four private promotional villas in Rouiba, delivered with complete all-trades execution (TCE) and integrated roads and utility networks (VRD).

faq.question: What civil works were executed on site?
faq.answer: The civil works included the installation of primary utility connections, site drainage, and the construction of dedicated vehicular and pedestrian access roads.

faq.question: What structural and architectural systems were used?
faq.answer: The villas feature cast-in-situ reinforced concrete frames with contemporary masonry envelopes, finished with modern exterior renders and integrated glazing systems.
